_OCC_REPO_NAME = "onex_change_control"
_OCC_REPO_OWNER = "OmniNode-ai"


def _is_occ_repo(repo: str) -> bool:
    parts = repo.strip().rstrip("/").rsplit("/", maxsplit=1)
    if parts[-1] != _OCC_REPO_NAME:
        return False
    return len(parts) == 1 or parts[0] == _OCC_REPO_OWNER
